evidence_order_constraints: data_feasibility and novelty_publishability are evaluated only after topology gate evidence

evidence_rows.closure_requirement: answer or explicitly block the topology object, discrepancy, planted noisy-circle, sphere-control, Euclidean-baseline, and disconnected-graph questions
evidence_rows.freshness_or_event_position: after accepted Assay-bar and bound to the exact issued SPEC-01 brief subject
evidence_rows.identity_requirement: exact paper and reference-code commit identity, licence, environment, formulas, symmetrisation, eigenvalue handling, and heuristic guard
evidence_rows.producer_requirement: sealed accepted prospective producer relation revalidated at score recording

evidence_rows.closure_requirement: answer or explicitly block every data-feasibility question without survey microdata or numerical outcome inspection
evidence_rows.freshness_or_event_position: after accepted Assay-bar and bound to the exact issued SPEC-01 brief subject
evidence_rows.identity_requirement: exact future estimand, feature block, fit population, freeze rule, missingness, weighting, attrition, comparator, and resource envelope
evidence_rows.producer_requirement: sealed accepted prospective producer relation revalidated at score recording

evidence_rows.closure_requirement: answer or explicitly block whether the contribution is non-redundant and publishable
evidence_rows.freshness_or_event_position: after accepted Assay-bar and bound to the exact issued SPEC-01 brief subject
evidence_rows.identity_requirement: exact contribution class, primary claim, immutable source identities, and closest alternative
evidence_rows.producer_requirement: sealed accepted prospective producer relation revalidated at score recording

partial_conditions: required evidence is blocked or incomplete
stop_conditions: provider process or command-line launch by ARS
reviewed PROMOTE reaches an explicit owner decision and stops
